question: Who is declared to be the presiding deity of the ajapā mantra?
premises: The mantra has a presiding deity.
That deity is identified as the origin of the worlds.
That deity is named as the lord of Girijā.
inference: The presiding deity of this mantra is declared to be the lord of Girijā, the origin of the worlds.
plain_english: Its deity is well declared to be the lord of Girijā, the origin of the worlds.
